name: linkedin-mcp
description: Drive LinkedIn from Claude — view profiles, search people/jobs/companies, message, connect, react, comment, and update your own profile.
long_description: A connect-only MCP server that attaches to the LinkedIn desktop app's browser over CDP. Install this bundle in one click; on first use it launches the desktop app (where you log in to LinkedIn once) and drives that same visible session — no Playwright browser download, no hand-edited config. Write actions are disabled by default and gated behind an explicit opt-in.

allow_mutations.title: Enable write actions
allow_mutations.description: Comma-separated allowlist of write actions to enable (e.g. send_message,comment,update_profile), or "all". Leave blank to keep every write action DISABLED (read-only). Write actions affect your real LinkedIn account.

tools.name: linkedin_get_profile
tools.description: Open and scrape a member profile.

tools.name: linkedin_update_profile
tools.description: Update your own profile (headline, about, name, location). Write action.

tools.name: linkedin_send_message
tools.description: Send a direct message. Write action.

tools.name: linkedin_send_connection
tools.description: Send a connection request. Write action.

tools.name: linkedin_comment
tools.description: Comment on a post. Write action.

tools.name: linkedin_react
tools.description: React to a post. Write action.
